title: Style learning và complete continuity
scope_items: Database Migration 00021: Created style_packs table (§22.7) with composite tenant foreign keys to workspaces, assets, and continuity_packs; added drift_score, drift_severity, drift_details to assets; added override_reason and resolved_at to continuity_violations (§7.5); strict multi-tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY); exact numeric money/credits (DB-H-001); narrow role grants to app_user and admin_user; and verified 21-step reversible down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (15s preview quoted): Character builder Step 3 quotes 15s duration, bounded credit quote (5 credits), and verifies spend authority before rendering test preview (RULE-M08-001, AC 1).

Acceptance Target 2 (High drift blocks readiness): Assets with drift score > 60 (high_drift) create a blocking violation in continuity_violations table and are blocked from ready/approved state unless explicitly overridden by Manager+ with justification (RULE-M08-005, AC 4).

Acceptance Target 3 (Consent withdrawal prevents new use): Likeness consent revocation immediately invalidates linked digital twins and blocks all subsequent generation, character preview, dubbing, or voiceover (RULE-M08-002, EC-M08-001).

EF-07 Style Learning & Transfer (Screen W032): Upload 1-5 reference videos, extract 7 aesthetic style parameters (color grading, lighting, camera movement, pace/cadence, composition, texture/grain, audio atmosphere), save reusable style pack, and apply to subsequent video generation pipelines.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_15sPreviewQuoted (Go -race), Vitest web suite (continuity_drift.test.ts), and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm 15s preview duration quote, fixed 5 credits cost, and spend authority gating.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_HighDriftBlocksReadiness (Go -race), Vitest web suite, and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm >60 drift score triggers high_drift severity and blocking violation, blocks approval, and requires Manager+ explicit override justification.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_ConsentWithdrawalPreventsNewUse (Go -race), Vitest web suite, and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm consent revocation immediately cascades to invalidate digital twins and blocks character preview and generation.

EF-07 Style Learning & Transfer Verified: TestEF07_StyleExtractionAndTransfer (Go -race), W032 UI route (/studio/style-learning), Vitest suite, and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm 1-5 video extraction, 15 credit quote, 7 aesthetic parameters, and style pack persistence.
Migration 00021 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 21 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: proto-gen.sh verify passes Buf lint, codegen across Go, TypeScript, and Dart, git drift verification, TypeScript compilation, and Dart generated code analyze.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_web_smoke.sh (SSR HTTP 200 on /studio/style-learning and /studio/quick-edit), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), vitest (180 tests passing), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze 0 issues, 164 tests passing) all pass cleanly.
external_gates: Production multi-video style extraction and transfer models require production Vision-Language API credentials and live billing accounts. Local provider engine with realistic 7-parameter extraction and 15 credit quotes verified locally.
Production 15s preview video rendering (veo-preview-fast) requires production model API keys. Local fast-preview generator and spend authority checks verified locally.

Migration 00021 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow role grants verified via local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.

remaining_scope.note: Packaging QA and derivative asset lineage bulk operations.

decisions: ADR-P4-07-001: Model 15s preview duration with a fixed 5 credit cost quote that verifies user spend authority prior to generation invocation.
ADR-P4-07-002: Enforce threshold of >60 for high_drift severity which creates an unbypassed blocking record in continuity_violations requiring Manager+ explicit override.
ADR-P4-07-003: Consent withdrawal on digital twin likeness cascades immediately to invalidate linked characters from generation pipelines and preview.
ADR-P4-07-004: Style learning (EF-07) extracts 7 core parameters (color grade, lighting, camera, pace, composition, texture, audio atmosphere) with a 15-credit quote for 1-5 videos.
